articles.title: Explained: 2 key developments driving RVNL, Ircon and other railway stocks higher
articles.summary: Five railway multitracking projects worth around Rs 10,021 crore have been approved across South India, adding about 540 km to the Indian Railways network. Three more projects worth Rs 10,783 crore were cleared across five states. The projects are expected to boost rail capacity, ease congestion, improve connectivity and support incremental freight movement over the coming years.

articles.title: CCI closes real money games-related case against Google
articles.summary: In 2022, Winzo Games Pvt Ltd filed a complaint against Google alleging restrictions for Real Money Games (RMG) on Google Play and about advertisement policy, among others. The Competition Commission of India (CCI) in 2024 ordered a detailed probe into the matter. Google made a commitment offering to address the anti-competition concerns, and the Online Gaming Act came into force from May 2026.

articles.title: India may restart bilateral investment treaty talks with UK as model text nears finalisation
articles.summary: India is close to finalizing its model text for bilateral investment treaty talks with the United Kingdom. Internal discussions on the draft agreement are nearly complete and cabinet approval is expected soon. The government is reviewing measures to make the treaty more attractive for foreign investors. This comes after previous talks stalled over taxation issues and international arbitration cases.

articles.title: What Is a Tokenised Bond? How India's first blockchain bond will actually work and why it matters
articles.summary: India's capital markets have taken a significant step toward blockchain-based finance. State-owned REC Ltd. has raised ₹500 crore through India's first tokenised corporate bond issue. The issue received subscriptions for over 8 times the issue size. It's a landmark moment in the ongoing efforts to make India's bond market faster, cheaper, and deeper.
